verdict.rationale: Rollbar ships an AI agent (Resolve), so letting users plug in external MCP servers is a fair question for this product. The evidence only documents Rollbar's own MCP server, which external AI tools like Claude or Cursor run to access Rollbar data. That is the server role and does not count toward this client-side story. Nothing in the pack shows Rollbar or Resolve connecting to or using third-party MCP servers' tools.
